messages:
mara: Quick FYI — UnivX (edu POC) asking for custom commit slab not in public ratecard. Asking for ~50k tokens/day for 6 months, requesting ~40% off for the POC window. Need Deal Desk + Finance + Legal signoff before we commit.
jonp: Do we have ARR or conversion estimates to justify 40%? Any billing/usage red flags?
liz: @mara add a 1-pager with expected usage & SFDC contact. Deal Desk can fast-track if win probability documented and finance approves. Also confirm quota pool implications.
mara: Details: contact emily@univx.edu, POC start 2026-04-05, use case: essay scoring + embeddings. Forecast: 50k tokens/day → ~9M/month → 54M total over 6 months. Expected conversion 60%. CRM: https://redwood.example/crm/CASE-3245
ashok: Finance ok with large disco for POC if treated as committed (prepay/commit). Need: (1) committed volume SKU, (2) billing cadence (monthly vs prepaid), (3) rev rec guidance. Refundable credits require different booking.
sam_pm: We can create a temporary override in rc-v3 tagged `edu-poc-override` so public SKUs unchanged. Auto-expire after 6 months. Deal Desk + Legal must sign off.
anna_legal: Need (1) plain-English description of nonstandard terms (discount, duration, rollback), (2) confirmation no SLA/data-handling changes. Decide MSA amendment vs SOW addendum.
liz: Deal Desk workflow: A) create Deal Desk ticket with forecast & SFDC, B) attach finance note and legal language, C) Deal Desk proposes override SKU and temp contract clause. Approval within 48h after attachments.
mara: Opening ticket now.
mara: Ticket DD-2026-781 created: https://redwood.example/deal-desk/DD-2026-781 — tagged #edu-poc-override. Escalate for 48h turnaround.
deploy-bot: @mara ratecard override branch created: git.redwood/ratecards/overrides/edu-poc-DD-2026-781
sam_pm: Proposed override snippet (internal):
```
commit_override:
  sku: edu-poc-50k
  discount: 0.40
  duration_months: 6
  cap_behavior: "hard_cap"
  auto_expire_ts: 1769025600
```
liz: Clarify: 1) discount applied to list price or post-tier? 2) include minimum monthly commit or flexible?
mara: Discount on list price. Customer will prepay first 2 months to secure capacity, then monthly billing. Minimum equals 50k/day or $ equivalent at list price.
ashok: Prefer prepaid first 2 months to reduce churn. We'll invoice month 1 upfront, month 2 as prepay credit after signature, then monthly invoices. Confirm tax jurisdiction (CA vs DE) with customer.
anna_legal: Confirm data residency & PII handling — FERPA concerns if student data. Ask customer to complete security questionnaire.
mara: Emily will fill security questionnaire. I'll ask about FERPA and tax jurisdiction in the same thread.
jonp: Any capacity blocking? Eng/Infra needs heads-up if we should reserve Dedicated slots.
sam_pm: Recommend hosted with soft reserved pool; if guaranteed latency required, dedicate small Dedicated reserve (impacts price). Prefer hosted for flexibility.
liz: After approval Deal Desk will create private ratecard entry with metadata: team=edu-sales, override_id=DD-2026-781, tags=[edu-poc]. Auto-expiry will alert owners and trigger post-mortem.
mara: Updated DD-2026-781: customer answered FERPA=no student PII ingested, tax=CA, LOI attached. Ping @liz for final review.
liz: Reviewing and left a comment on DD-2026-781 about minimum commit calc. Will approve override and request billing to prepare prepaid invoice.
deploy-bot: @liz Override `edu-poc-50k` created in private ratecard (version rc-v3.4.1-edu). Auto-expiry 1769025600. Audit ID: OV-2026-324.
jonp: Nice. Ship billing flow and tell Eng if Dedicated reservation is needed. I'll only engage customer after approval.
mara: Thanks all — will confirm once invoice sent. :thumbsup:
